args.description: 2D side-view beat 'em up stage background, Streets of Rage 2 pixel art, strictly flat orthographic side view, the camera looks straight at the wall with NO perspective and no vanishing point, no text, no letters, no people. Moscow City business district plaza at Presnenskaya embankment: in front a long glass and steel vaulted arcade roof on slim steel columns, the glass entrance of a huge shopping mall, behind it glass skyscrapers of Moscow City rising to the top edge, overcast evening sky. Dystopian post-cyberpunk gulag mood: barbed wire coils on top of steel fences, surveillance cameras on poles, giant blank propaganda screens glowing red and cyan, concrete anti-ram blocks, grey smog, cold neon light. Floor: grey granite paving slabs. Bottom 48% of the image: wide empty walkable floor seen slightly from above, the base of the wall meets the floor in one straight horizontal line, nothing standing on the floor.
